purpose_and_thesis: In its founding terms (README/prometheus_thesis_v2, 2026-05-02): prove that 'hallucinations as mutation, falsification as selection' can dominate — that a falsification-first substrate turns generative variance into discovery, with the kill ledger becoming a trainable gradient field ('the question this project tests is whether the second can dominate the first'). The pivot/ corpus itself exists as the program's second-order commitment: apply falsification-first to the program's own self-understanding — every thesis ships with kill conditions, every reassessment logs dissent as first-class, 'an honest this-thesis-died is a first-class finding.' The arc under survey is the record of that second-order discipline working (theses killed on schedule, dissents filed and later vindicated) while first-order execution repeatedly failed to follow (the corrections were designed, filed, and not run).
strategic_read: Three things stand out. (1) The self-understanding machinery is the program's best-functioning subsystem and its narcotic. Every formulation of the north star was killed or demoted by the program's own instruments, honestly and with citations — NS-1 by its own 0-PROMOTE refutation condition and M0; the one-spine funnel by James's R3/R4; M0's headline by the 08-12 panel within 24h of the fleet standing on it. But v1's most important sentence ('the program lacks a single re-running gate that enforces the lessons it has already written down') has now been true through three more cycles: M1 never built, README never corrected, Q2 retrospective still blank, claim-ledger never operationalized. The arc predicts that any plan whose deliverable is prose will be executed and any plan whose deliverable is a wired loop will not. The orchestrator should weight the 08-12 plans by that prior and treat 'runnable artifact or it didn't happen' (STRATEGY §6.3) as the only enforcement mechanism with a track record — enforced by the harness, not by doctrine. (2) The v3-vs-Techne disagreement is the load-bearing fork, and it partially resolved itself. Exact points: (a) identity — v3: Prometheus IS the instrument/progress-meter; the organism is an external candidate it grades; Techne: instrument and organism are one loop — a substrate that metabolizes its own kill-geometry emits the progress signal as a byproduct, and splitting them 'promotes the passive-consumer failure mode to the official thesis'; (b) epistemics of the arbitration — v2 treats ChatGPT cross-family convergence as the headline corroboration; Techne reads the same event through the program's own feedback_llm_convergence_is_gravity_amplifier doctrine as the maximally in-distribution answer pulling the chain into the safe 'you're really a validation layer' framing; (c) sequencing — v2 puts gate-hardening (M0.5/CC-1) in Phase 0; Techne demotes it to hygiene because his own E3 showed the gate was never load-bearing (demo-scale kernel, 2,351 = formula fossil, 413M records nothing metabolizes) and promotes M1-as-metabolization to the single decisive experiment; (d) the decisive question — v3: 'can Prometheus tell whether a candidate is getting closer?'; Techne: 'can a model metabolize the kill-geometry and change behavior because of it?'; (e) v3's candidate-organism slot risks smuggling the LLM-dead-end back in as the reasoner (inverting the Silver bet); (f) don't garden exploratory breadth. Steelman of v3: it is the only formulation the empirical record could support (M0 later confirmed the selector can't see novelty; advertising B was indefensible), it subsumes rather than discards B, it ships its own Goodhart guard, and it does not dodge the keystone — it raises M0's stakes. Steelman of Techne: the subsequent six silent weeks are exactly what his dissent predicted an instrument-identity produces ('went quiet without any falsification event — not by being wrong, by running out of things to measure'), and the 08-12 consensus experiment is literally his §5.3 collapsed onto new hardware — while James's R3/R4 vindicated his anti-gardening stand. The honest settlement, visible in today's docs: v3 remains the constitution (what it's FOR), Techne's metabolization probe is the agenda (what to DO), Charon's navigability gate is embedded as the probe's null arm, and math is re-roled as calibration standard per R1. That is a coherent, better position than any single June document. (3) The real risk is now epistemics-at-scale, not direction: the 08-12 fossil finding (4 of 6 agents citing a number falsified the same day; 'exactly one executed the code and five cited a summary') generalizes — the pivot corpus is large enough that citation now outcompetes execution as evidence. Whatever the orchestrator builds next should make claims carry their reproduction command (v2 §3e, still unbuilt) and should spend the two unspent cheap wins first: the B′ benchmark (grade it once) and the one-line prometheus_math unbrick, both prerequisites for the probe that decides whether the 20-year bet's substrate emits signal or exhaust.
